timeout.description:
Timeout in seconds for the chain that contains the current node.
Typically this field is only populated by the head of the chain.

next.description: The next node in the chain

head.description: The head of the chain that contains the current node

catchChain.description:
If the current node is a head, it can have a catch chain that runs when the normal
chain fails.

asyncQueue.description: If the node spawns a nested async queue, its chains (heads) will be stored here.

skipQueueFlag.description: Whether to skip the remaining chains in the queue

func.description: The function that yields a promise

args.description:
Additional arguments to be passed to the function ({@link #func}). A Luke instance and the result resolved from
the previous node will be passed, followed by the additional arguments.

label.description: Metadata about what type of node this is.

uuid.description: "Unique" id assigned to each LukeAsyncQueueNode for UI. Uses C3 unique ID generator, but not backed by database

title: A subtype of {@link LukeAsyncQueueNode} that resolves with a jasmine.Spy
name: LukeAsyncQueueSpy
